zoomOut: 𝐙𝐨𝐨𝐦 𝐨𝐮𝐭: In 1990, acid rain fell on more than 41% of Europe's ecosystems at damaging levels. By 2020 it was about 7%, after sulphur emissions fell by almost 95%. (European Environment Agency)

quote.text: Never doubt that a small group of thoughtful, committed citizens can change the world; indeed, it's the only thing that ever has.

slides.summary: Content creator Josh Liljenquist's GoFundMe for Detroit mom Azeza Kasham and her son Gigi, who has Lafora disease, raised nearly $600,000 in under two months.
slides.headline: GoFundMe raises nearly 600000 for boy with Lafora disease
slides.proves: Liljenquist's fundraising model, already used for a man's new roof and a pay-what-you-can cafe, could reach more families facing rare diseases.

slides.summary: UC Davis researchers used brain implants to let two ALS patients speak and sing again, lifting word intelligibility to 94 percent.
slides.headline: Brain implants help ALS patients speak and sing again
slides.proves: The intelligibility jump shows brain-to-voice implants can move from lab demonstration to real conversation for people who have lost speech to ALS.

slides.summary: England's rivers have seen PFOS and PFOA levels drop 30 percent and 29 percent over the past decade, new Environment Agency data confirm.
slides.headline: England rivers see PFOS and PFOA levels drop over decade
slides.proves: The same restriction approach used for PFOS and PFOA could cut levels of the thousands of other forever chemicals still unregulated.
